notes.title: Early Access V9 - Sounds and Noises
notes.content:
Added a more vibrant audio setting to the game. 
Guests, cars, cutting the kebab, the kebab grill itself and many things more now make noises.

tags.feature: Added a more vibrant audio setting to the game.

notes.title: Early Access V8 - Challenge Mode
notes.content:
The earlier announced challenge mode is now available. 
Race against the time fulfilling the orders of a horde of customers. 
-------
Additional bug fixes:
Fixed orientation issues when frier container hits ordering queue
